games.title: 13th Floor
games.description: A first-person stealth horror game that fits in 13 kilobytes, and the overall winner of js13kGames 2024. Search a hotel floor room by room for keys while hiding from whatever is hunting you.
games.how_to_play: Click to start. WASD to move and the mouse to look. Press E or left-click to interact and F to toggle your flashlight. Find the keys and avoid being caught.

games.title: 3D Tank Battle
games.description: An intense multiplayer tank battle game in 3D. Battle against other players in real-time tank combat with realistic physics and explosive action.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD or arrow keys to drive your tank, tank turrets auto-fire. On mobile, use the virtual joystick to move!

games.title: AFK City
games.description: A relaxing low-poly city builder that can build itself. Watch a city grow from a settlement into a skyline on its own, or take over and zone and design it yourself.
games.how_to_play: Choose a mode and press Play. Auto grows the city while you watch, Classic lets you zone and design it with the mouse, and Survive is the third mode to try once you know the basics.

games.title: Bichitos Rumble
games.description: An arena brawler where nine animal characters headbutt each other off a platform. Each critter has its own abilities and an ultimate. Play against bots, online with up to four players, or with friends. No sign-up.
games.how_to_play: WASD to move, Space to headbutt, J and K for abilities and L for your ultimate. Press R to restart. Knock your rivals off the edge and be the last one standing. Gamepads are supported.

games.title: BotGrid
games.description: A real-time territory strategy game on a neon circuit board. Build robots that claim nodes, fight rivals and hack enemy Cores while you power your network out from your own Core. Take on up to five AI rivals from Easy to Brutal, or play online with friends. Free in your browser on phone or desktop.
games.how_to_play: Own 3 of a cell's 4 corner nodes to claim it and earn energy, then spend energy on bots: Build bots claim nodes, Strike bots fight and Hack bots break enemy nodes and Cores. Nodes cut off from your Core go dark. Win by crashing every rival Core or by holding most of the grid for 40 seconds. Keyboard: drag or WASD to pan, wheel to zoom, 1-9 to build, U to upgrade, Space to jump home. Touch: drag to look, pinch to zoom, tap a bot to build it.

games.title: Bruno Simon Portfolio
games.description: An interactive 3D portfolio where you drive a car through a playful environment
games.how_to_play: Use WASD or arrow keys to drive the car. Click and drag to look around. On mobile, use the virtual joystick!

games.title: Bullet Force
games.description: A modern multiplayer FPS with realistic graphics and a wide variety of weapons. Experience intense combat with multiple game modes, customizable loadouts, and special abilities.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, mouse to aim, and click to shoot. Press R to reload, Space to jump, and C to crouch. On mobile, use the virtual joystick and buttons. Earn kill streaks to unlock special abilities!

games.title: Bullet Fury 2
games.description: A 3D first-person shooter with arcade-style gameplay. Battle through various levels filled with enemies using a variety of weapons. Features fast-paced action, power-ups, and boss fights in a stylized 3D environment designed to run smoothly in browsers.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, mouse to aim, and left-click to shoot. Press Space to jump, Shift to sprint, and R to reload. Collect new weapons and power-ups throughout levels to increase your combat effectiveness. Eliminate all enemies in each area to progress through the game.

games.title: Dasher 3D
games.description: A top-down shooter with innovative time-freezing mechanics. Navigate through minimalist 3D environments while time only moves when you move. Plan your attacks carefully as enemies and their projectiles only advance when you do, creating a unique puzzle-like combat experience.
games.how_to_play: Use a single button (mouse click or space) to move forward in the direction you're facing. Time only progresses when you move, allowing you to plan your path through enemy fire. Rotate your view with the mouse to change direction. Reach the exit in each level while avoiding or eliminating enemies.

games.title: Daybreak
games.description: A free 3D battle royale on a shrinking island. Twelve contestants smash crates for weapons, chain hits into heavy finishers and dodge-roll out of danger. A supply drop lands at every daybreak and the tide rises every night. Last one standing wins. Play online or solo against bots, in your browser on phone or desktop.
games.how_to_play: WASD to move, mouse or drag to look, click or J to attack, Space to jump, Shift or right-click to dodge-roll, Q to switch weapons, Tab for the scoreboard. Walk over loot to take it and over food to heal. Land three hits in a row for a heavy finisher, and keep to high ground at night because the sea drains your health. Touch: left thumb moves, drag on the right to look, the big button attacks.

games.title: Drift Hunters
games.description: A realistic 3D drifting game with a focus on authentic drift mechanics and car customization. Features a variety of real-world inspired cars that can be upgraded and tuned for optimal drifting performance. Earn points by performing stylish drifts across multiple tracks and environments.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD or arrow keys to control your car: W/Up to accelerate, S/Down to brake/reverse, A/D or Left/Right to steer. Space for handbrake to initiate drifts. Earn money from successful drifts to upgrade your car's performance and appearance. Master the art of controlling your car through corners while maintaining a drift for maximum points.

games.title: Farm Clash 3D
games.description: A unique third-person shooter set in a colorful farm environment. Battle against other players using farm-themed weapons and characters in various game modes. Features team-based gameplay, multiple maps, and a lighthearted, humorous approach to the shooter genre.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and Shift to sprint. Mouse to aim and left-click to shoot. Press R to reload and Q/E to switch weapons. On mobile, use the virtual joystick and on-screen buttons. Work with your team to defeat the opposing team and complete objectives.

games.title: Fields of Fury
games.description: A World War II-themed capture the flag FPS built with PlayCanvas. Battle against other players in team-based matches across historically inspired maps. Features multiple soldier classes, authentic weapons, and vehicles from the era in a fast-paced multiplayer environment.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and Shift to sprint. Mouse to aim and left-click to shoot. Press E to interact with objects or enter vehicles. Choose your class and work with your team to capture the enemy flag while defending your own. Use period-appropriate weapons and tactics to secure victory.

games.title: FLOAT
games.description: First-person momentum parkour through huge concrete monoliths hanging in the sky. Chain wall runs, slides and wall jumps to cross nine sectors. There is no combat, only movement.
games.how_to_play: WASD to move and Shift to sprint. Jump with Space, the right mouse button or the wheel. Ctrl to slide or stomp. Keep your speed up and link moves together.

games.title: Fly.Pieter.com
games.description: A fun free-to-play MMO flight sim, made with AI. Fly and dogfight with your friends online.
games.how_to_play: Fly your plane with the controls on your keyboard or using the virtual joystick on mobile

games.title: Freeze Out
games.description: A first-person snowball fight: four against four with bots across eight winter maps, from an alpine village to an ice rink. It has three game modes and tournament cups, and no ads.
games.how_to_play: Works with keyboard and mouse, touch or a gamepad. Click or tap to throw a snowball, and hold to wind up a longer throw. Choose Quick match to jump in, or Training to practise first.

games.title: Heraclos
games.description: A short, polished 3D adventure about a reluctant hero in ancient Greece, made as a graduation project at the Gobelins school. The story is split into chapters.
games.how_to_play: Pick a quality level to match your computer, then start a new game. Follow the on-screen prompts through each chapter; you can return to any chapter from the menu.

games.title: HexGL
games.description: A futuristic racing game inspired by F-Zero and Wipeout. Race through stunning neon tracks in this WebGL-powered game, featuring smooth controls and high-speed action.
games.how_to_play: Use arrow keys to control your hovercraft. Up/Down to accelerate/brake, Left/Right to steer. On mobile, use the virtual joystick. Collect power-ups and race against the clock!

games.title: Hollowlands
games.description: A third-person survival and crafting game in a stylised, procedurally generated world. Explore, gather resources, craft tools, build and fight, on your own or online with other players.
games.how_to_play: Choose Singleplayer or Online Multiplayer. WASD to move, Shift to run, Space to jump and R to open your inventory. The first quests on screen get you started.

games.title: Huss Valley Game
games.description: Free multiplayer Halloween chase game in the browser: pumpkin-headed trick-or-treaters race across a field to the finish while up to 4 ghosts hunt them. Up to 30 players per room, WebGL, no download, no account.
games.how_to_play: Press Play to join a live room. Trick-or-treaters: run from START to FINISH with WASD/arrow keys (or the on-screen joystick on phones), grabbing candy for points and a speed boost. Ghosts: leave the haunted house and catch runners with a swipe attack. Gamepads are supported.

games.title: Interland
games.description: An educational 3D game by Google that teaches kids about online safety through interactive adventures. Explore four different lands while learning about digital citizenship, security, and kindness.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD or arrow keys to move around. Click to interact with objects and complete challenges. On mobile, use the virtual joystick and tap to interact. Follow the on-screen instructions to complete each level.

games.title: Jolly Roger
games.description: An open-world 3D pirate adventure. Sail an open sea, trade between harbors, fight rival ships broadside to broadside, board and capture them, and go ashore anywhere to dig up buried treasure. Hunt down four captains for the pieces of a legendary map. Free in your browser on phone or desktop, with no account and nothing to buy.
games.how_to_play: A and D steer, W and S set or furl the sails, and drag to look around; she is fastest with the wind behind her. Fire a broadside with Space when a gun button glows, or pick a side with Q and E. Come alongside a crippled ship and press F to board, then click to cut and hold Shift to guard. Press F to dock at a harbor, anchor off a beach to swim ashore, and press F on a red X to dig. On touch, steer with the left stick.

games.title: Kacho Refine
games.description: A 3D remake of a 1998 panel puzzle game. Guide a penguin to the goal by turning the arrow tiles it walks over, while germ enemies follow the same arrows. It has 30 stages and a stage builder for making your own.
games.how_to_play: Turn the arrow panels with the mouse or touch to steer the penguin. Collect the four panels on each stage, then reach the goal. Switch the language to English on the loading screen. The first load takes about 30 seconds.

games.title: Keep Out!
games.description: A first-person dungeon crawler by Little Workshop. Explore the dungeon room by room, fight the monsters inside and unlock new weapons as you go.
games.how_to_play: Press Play Now and pick your keyboard layout. The How to play screen then shows the keys for moving and fighting.

games.title: Kirka.io
games.description: A block-style FPS with different game modes including team deathmatch, free-for-all, and capture the flag. Features a variety of weapons, character customization, and maps with a distinctive voxel aesthetic. Earn experience and currency to unlock new items and upgrades as you play.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and Shift to sprint. Mouse to aim and left-click to shoot. Press R to reload and Q for special abilities. Numbers 1-9 to switch weapons. On mobile, use the virtual joystick and buttons. Choose your preferred game mode and work with your team or dominate solo depending on the mode.

games.title: Krunker.io
games.description: A fast-paced first-person shooter with low-poly graphics and advanced movement mechanics. Choose from multiple classes with unique abilities and weapons, customize your character, and compete in various game modes. Known for its quick matches and skill-based gameplay.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and Shift to crouch. Mouse to aim and click to shoot. Advanced players use slide-hopping (jump + crouch while moving) for faster movement. On mobile, use the virtual controls to move and shoot.

games.title: Madalin Stunt Cars 2
games.description: An open-world stunt driving game with a selection of high-performance cars and large maps to explore. Perform incredible stunts, drifts, and jumps across multiple detailed environments. Features multiplayer mode where you can show off your driving skills to other players.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD or arrow keys to drive: W/Up to accelerate, S/Down to brake/reverse, A/D or Left/Right to steer. Press Space for handbrake to drift. R to reset your car if you get stuck. On mobile, use the on-screen controls. Explore the maps freely and challenge yourself to perform impressive stunts.

games.title: Mana Blade
games.description: A free anime-styled 3D multiplayer RPG that drops you straight onto a tutorial beach with no sign-up. Fight the demons that are stealing the world's mana, alongside other players.
games.how_to_play: WASD to run and move the mouse to look around. Follow the on-screen tutorial to learn the rest.

games.title: Minecraft Classic
games.description: Mojang's official browser release of the original 2009 creative build of Minecraft. Wander a small block world and build with the 32 original blocks. No mobs, no survival, and no account needed.
games.how_to_play: WASD to move, Space to jump and the mouse to look. Use the mouse buttons to break and place blocks. Press B to choose a block, or use the number keys for the hotbar.

games.title: Moon Rider
games.description: A musical rhythm game where you surf a cosmic road, built with A-Frame for WebXR. Slash through targets and dodge obstacles in time with the music. Features multiple game modes, a large library of songs, and support for both VR headsets and standard browser play with impressive 3D visuals.
games.how_to_play: In browser mode, use your mouse to slash through targets in the direction indicated. In VR mode, use your controllers to cut targets and dodge obstacles. Choose from different game modes including classic, punch, and ride modes. Select from a variety of songs with different difficulty levels and enjoy the immersive audio-visual experience.

games.title: Narrow One
games.description: A unique multiplayer first-person archery game with a minimalist art style. Compete in team-based capture-the-flag matches using bow and arrow as your primary weapon. Features multiple character classes, maps, and strategic gameplay focused on precision and teamwork.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and Shift to sprint. Hold left mouse button to draw your bow and release to shoot. Right-click to zoom/aim. Press Q/E to switch abilities. On mobile, use the virtual joystick and on-screen buttons. Work with your team to capture the enemy flag while defending your own.

games.title: Neuro Cookie Quest 3D
games.description: A fan-made 3D platformer created for the Neuro-sama game jam. Guide the character through colorful levels collecting cookies while avoiding obstacles and enemies. Features charming low-poly graphics, platforming challenges, and puzzle elements in a compact game experience.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD or arrow keys to move, Space to jump, and Shift to sprint. Collect all the cookies in each level to progress. Navigate platforms, avoid hazards, and solve simple puzzles to reach your goal. The game combines classic platforming mechanics with a cute aesthetic in a browser-friendly package.

games.title: Nine Loops: Subway
games.description: An anomaly-spotting loop game set in a cyberpunk subway. You walk the same corridor again and again, looking for anything that has changed while you search for a missing girl in a red hood. Free, in English or Japanese.
games.how_to_play: Walk down the corridor. If you notice anything unusual, turn back; if everything looks normal, keep going. Nine correct choices in a row gets you out, and a wrong one resets the count. Keyboard on desktop and touch on phones; the Controls menu lists the keys.

games.title: Om Nom: Run
games.description: A colorful 3D endless runner featuring the lovable character Om Nom from the Cut the Rope series. Run through vibrant environments, collect candies, avoid obstacles, and use power-ups to achieve high scores in this family-friendly arcade game.
games.how_to_play: Swipe left or right to change lanes, swipe up to jump, and swipe down to slide. On desktop, use arrow keys or WASD. Collect candies for points and power-ups to help you progress further. Avoid obstacles to keep running as long as possible!

games.title: Outlier: Unlimited Krillion Game
games.description: A free unlimited Krillion-style rare-answer trivia game with no daily cap. Name something that fits the category; the rarer your correct answer, the further your cat pilot's UFO flies over a pixel-art city.
games.how_to_play: You get a category (e.g. name a river, a cheese, an NBA team) and one answer. Type your answer: obvious picks score a little, rare correct picks score a lot. Your S/A/B grade decides how far the UFO flies. Play in any browser, desktop or mobile, no download.

games.title: Pixel Warfare
games.description: A fast-paced multiplayer FPS game with pixel graphics. Battle against other players in various game modes with a wide selection of weapons and maps. The blocky, retro aesthetic combines with modern FPS gameplay for a unique shooting experience.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, mouse to aim, and click to shoot. Press R to reload, Space to jump, and Shift to sprint. On mobile, use the virtual joystick and buttons to control your character and weapons.

games.title: Plume
games.description: A beautiful third-person adventure game with a unique art style and stunning visual effects. Explore a mysterious world and solve puzzles in this atmospheric experience.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, mouse to look around, and click to interact with objects. On mobile, use the virtual joystick and tap to interact. Collect items and solve puzzles to progress through the story.

games.title: PolyTrack
games.description: A low-poly 3D racing game with a built-in track editor. Race through colorful tracks in arcade-style gameplay with drift mechanics and time trials. Create and share your own tracks with the community, featuring an intuitive track editor and multiple vehicle options.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD or arrow keys to control your vehicle: W/Up to accelerate, S/Down to brake/reverse, A/D or Left/Right to steer. Hold Space to drift. On mobile, use the on-screen controls. Race against the clock in time trials or create your own tracks in the editor mode.

games.title: Riviera Rivals
games.description: A 15-minute strategy card game played on a 3D seaside resort. Draft rooms and amenities from a shared market, earn the best guest reviews and out-build the neighbouring resorts. Play solo against bots or online with a friend.
games.how_to_play: Played with the mouse. Start with Learn to play for a guided game, then choose Play now for a match against two bots, or share a room code with a friend. The rulebook is linked from the menu.

games.title: Rocket Bot Royale
games.description: A side-scrolling tank battle game with a focus on physics and destruction. Control a tank equipped with rockets and other weapons, battling against other players in a last-tank-standing format. Features destructible terrain, power-ups, and strategic gameplay in a 2D environment with 3D graphics.
games.how_to_play: Use A/D or Left/Right arrows to move your tank. Adjust your firing angle with W/S or Up/Down. Press Space to fire your weapon. Collect power-ups and coins to upgrade your tank and weapons. The rising water level forces players to move upward as the match progresses. Be the last tank surviving to win!

games.title: RuneScape
games.description: The iconic MMORPG with a browser-accessible version. Explore the vast fantasy world of Gielinor with thousands of other players. Features hundreds of quests, dozens of skills to master, PvP combat, player-driven economy, and regular content updates in a persistent online world with 20+ years of development.
games.how_to_play: Use mouse clicks to move, interact with objects, and attack enemies. Access skills, inventory, and other menus through the interface. Choose between the modern RS3 version or Old School RuneScape for a classic experience. Create a character and develop various skills like combat, crafting, and magic while completing quests and interacting with other players.

games.title: Shell Shockers
games.description: A unique multiplayer FPS where you play as an egg character in intense arena battles. Choose from various weapons and compete against other players in this quirky and fun shooter.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, mouse to aim, and click to shoot. On mobile, use the virtual joystick and buttons. Choose your weapon and try to crack your opponents' shells!

games.title: Sky Critters
games.description: Fly a drone over a toy-like 3D city and shoot down waves of flying critters before they reach your base tower. Earn coins to upgrade your gear, alone or in multiplayer.
games.how_to_play: WASD to fly, mouse to look, Space and Shift to go up and down, and click to shoot. Keys 1-4 switch weapons. M mutes sounds and N mutes music.

games.title: Slow Roads
games.description: An endless driving game with no traffic, no timer and no goal. The road, hills and scenery are generated as you go, so you can cruise for as long as you like. Runs straight in the browser with nothing to install.
games.how_to_play: Click begin, then steer with WASD. Press F to switch on autodrive and just watch the scenery. The hints shown at the start list the other keys.

games.title: Smash Karts
games.description: A chaotic multiplayer kart racing game with power-ups and battle elements. Race and battle against other players in colorful arenas, collecting weapons and power-ups to take out opponents. Features simple controls, vibrant graphics, and fast-paced gameplay suitable for all ages.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD or arrow keys to drive your kart: W/Up to accelerate, S/Down to brake/reverse, A/D or Left/Right to steer. Drive over power-up boxes to collect weapons, then click or press Space to use them. Earn points by taking out other players and surviving longer than your opponents. Last kart standing wins!

games.title: Stovetop
games.description: A cooking simulation set in a detailed 3D kitchen. Make popcorn, eggs, pancakes, spaghetti aglio e olio and a pan-seared steak on a gas hob where the heat, oil, water and flame are all simulated.
games.how_to_play: Tap to open, then use the mouse to pick up ingredients and tools and to work the hob. The cookbook in the kitchen has the recipes; nothing else tells you the steps. Best with sound on.

games.title: Summer Afternoon
games.description: A beautiful multiplayer 3D environment with a unique cartoon-style aesthetic. Explore this peaceful world with other players, featuring stunning shaders and a relaxing atmosphere.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD or arrow keys to move around. Click and drag to look around. On mobile, use the virtual joystick and touch to look around. Join other players in this shared space!

games.title: SWOOOP
games.description: A beautiful 3D flying game built with PlayCanvas where you pilot a biplane through a colorful island environment. Collect coins, fly through rings, and avoid obstacles in this arcade-style flying game with simple one-button controls and smooth gameplay.
games.how_to_play: Press and hold the mouse button or touch the screen to climb, release to dive. On mobile, simply tap and hold anywhere on the screen. Collect coins for points and fly through rings for speed boosts. Avoid obstacles like mountains and trees!

games.title: TANX
games.description: A fast team-based tank battle from the makers of the PlayCanvas engine. You are dropped straight into a live match with a random name; shoot the other teams' tanks to push your team's score up.
games.how_to_play: WASD to drive and the mouse to aim and shoot. On phones, use the two on-screen joysticks. Gamepads are supported.

games.title: Temple Run 2
games.description: The web version of the popular endless runner game where you escape from temple guardians through ancient ruins. Run, jump, slide and turn through challenging terrain while collecting coins and power-ups. Features beautiful 3D environments and increasingly difficult obstacles.
games.how_to_play: Swipe left or right to turn, swipe up to jump, and swipe down to slide. On desktop, use arrow keys: left/right to turn, up to jump, down to slide. Tilt your device (or use A/D keys) to move side to side for collecting coins. Avoid obstacles and run as far as possible!

games.title: The Aviator
games.description: A stylish 3D game where you fly a plane through a colorful world, collecting items. Originally created as a Three.js tutorial, this game features beautiful low-poly visuals, smooth animations, and simple yet engaging gameplay in a vibrant environment.
games.how_to_play: Use your mouse or touch input to control the plane's movement. Move the cursor left and right to steer the plane horizontally, up and down to control altitude. Collect the floating coins while avoiding obstacles. The game demonstrates core concepts of 3D web development with an appealing aesthetic.

games.title: The Cube
games.description: An interactive 3D Rubik's Cube puzzle built with Three.js. Solve the classic puzzle in your browser with smooth animations and intuitive controls. Features customizable cube sizes from 2x2 to 5x5, multiple difficulty levels, and the ability to scramble and reset the cube.
games.how_to_play: Click and drag on the cube faces to rotate them. Use the control panel to adjust settings like cube size and scramble difficulty. Solve the puzzle by aligning all colors on each face. For keyboard controls, use the arrow keys to rotate the cube view and WASD to rotate faces. A perfect demonstration of 3D manipulation in the browser.

games.title: The Frantic Run Of The Valorous Rabbit
games.description: An endless runner where you control a rabbit on a spherical world. Built with Three.js, this charming game features a unique perspective as you guide your rabbit around a planet, avoiding obstacles and collecting items. The distinctive art style and creative gameplay mechanics showcase the capabilities of 3D web technologies.
games.how_to_play: Use left and right arrow keys or A/D to move the rabbit around the planet. Jump with Space or the up arrow key to avoid obstacles. The game increases in difficulty as you progress, requiring quick reflexes and good timing. See how far you can run before hitting an obstacle!

games.title: Townscaper
games.description: The web demo of the town-building toy. Click on the open sea and colourful houses, arches, stairways and towers assemble themselves into an island town. There are no goals and no way to lose.
games.how_to_play: Left-click to add a block and right-click to remove one. Pick a colour from the palette on the left. Stack blocks and build over water to see how the houses connect. The first load takes around 20 seconds.

games.title: Tunnel Rush
games.description: A fast-paced 3D tunnel avoidance game built with Babylon.js. Speed through colorful geometric tunnels while avoiding obstacles that appear in your path. Features increasing difficulty, vibrant visuals with color-changing environments, and an adrenaline-pumping soundtrack.
games.how_to_play: Use left and right arrow keys or A/D to rotate the tunnel and avoid hitting obstacles. The game automatically propels you forward at increasing speeds. In two-player mode, each player controls half of the screen. React quickly to navigate through gaps in the obstacles and survive as long as possible.

games.title: Venge.io
games.description: A fast-paced multiplayer first-person shooter with stunning 3D graphics built on PlayCanvas. Features multiple game modes, character classes, and weapons with unique abilities. Known for its smooth performance and competitive gameplay in a browser-based environment.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and Shift to sprint. Mouse to aim and left-click to shoot, right-click for scope/aim. Press R to reload and Q for special abilities. On mobile, use the virtual joystick and on-screen buttons. Choose different weapons and classes to match your playstyle.

games.title: Vibesail
games.description: A relaxing 3D sailing experience where you navigate through beautiful waters and discover hidden islands. Perfect for unwinding and enjoying the peaceful atmosphere.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD or arrow keys to control your sailboat. Adjust the sails to catch the wind and navigate through the waters. On mobile, use the virtual joystick!

games.title: War Brokers
games.description: A voxel-style first-person shooter with various vehicles and game modes. Engage in team battles, capture the flag, or battle royale modes with a unique blocky aesthetic. Features tanks, helicopters, and other vehicles alongside traditional FPS combat.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and Shift to sprint. Mouse to aim and left-click to shoot. Press E to enter vehicles, Q for special abilities. On mobile, use the virtual controls. Work with your team to complete objectives or be the last player standing in battle royale mode.

games.title: Warzone 2100
games.description: The open-source 3D real-time strategy game from 1999, officially ported to the browser. Build a base, research technology, design your own tanks from parts and fight through the campaign or a skirmish against the AI.
games.how_to_play: Choose Play Now under Web Edition. The first run downloads about 60 MB of game data. Start the campaign or a skirmish, build structures and factories, research upgrades and send your units to destroy the enemy base. Played with mouse and keyboard.

games.title: xx142-b2.exe
games.description: A JS13kGames winner where you infiltrate an alien network as a virus. Navigate through a stylized representation of computer systems, avoiding detection while completing objectives. Features unique hacking mechanics, minimalist visuals, and an atmospheric soundtrack, all compressed into less than 13KB of JavaScript.
games.how_to_play: Use WASD or arrow keys to move through the network. Press Space or E to interact with nodes and systems. Avoid detection by security measures and complete your objectives to progress. The game presents a series of increasingly difficult puzzles that require stealth and strategy to overcome.
